## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected contract.

## Validation

List exact commands/procedures, environment and results. Separate local fixtures,
baseline failures and checks still pending from verified deployment behavior.

- [ ] Ran Python syntax and repository-configured Pylint checks; recorded any existing baseline failures.
- [ ] Ran relevant web regressions, or explained why they do not apply to this documentation-only change.
- [ ] Updated typed reST docstrings, API/operations examples and migration notes where affected.

## Rollout and review

- [ ] Documented paired deployment order, migration/backup/recovery requirements, or marked them not applicable.
- [ ] Kept secrets, generated files, shared-core changes and unrelated formatting out of scope.
- [ ] Identified any remaining operator checks; unchecked items are explained above.

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for author, reviewer and operator responsibilities.
